tasks.title: Detectar ferramentas e exibir cotas do Codex e orcamentos por ferramenta
tasks.description: Ocultar ferramentas ausentes, integrar Codex via app-server, eliminar budget global, configurar limites por ferramenta e validar app reinstalado.
tasks.evidence: App recompilado e reinstalado. Coleta real via Codex app-server e ccusage sem erros; somente Codex e OpenCode detectados, ambos sem orçamento monetario configurado. Cotas separadas de custos e limite global removido. Quatro testes passam: deteccao, budgets/alertas isolados, protocolo Codex multi-bucket e erro preservado. git diff --check limpo. Preview SwiftUI renderizado e inspecionado. AX do app conferido; cliques completos limitados por timeouts de CUA.

tasks.title: Excluir modelos gratuitos dos custos do OpenCode
tasks.description: Filtrar modelos free de totais, historico, modelos, sessoes e alertas; cobrir sessoes mistas com testes; atualizar app e verificar semana real.
tasks.evidence: Custos OpenCode recalculados pelos breakdowns, excluindo IDs -free/:free ou free; totais diario/semanal/mensal, historico, modelos e ranking de sessoes mistas corrigidos. Sem breakdown, erro explicito em vez de total contaminado. Sete testes passam e git diff --check limpo. App recompilado, relancado apos erro transitorio -600 do open, processo ativo e cache verificado: semana 7.3849 USD contra 64.47 anteriores. Render Week inspecionado.

tasks.title: Preservar budget global legado e configurar indicador da barra

tasks.evidence: Budget global diario legado e CLI --set-budget restaurados, com override de ambiente e desativacao explicita local. tasks.title: Calibrate Codex quota warning severity and readability
tasks.description: Keep the forecast accurate while matching color to urgency: use red only for near-term exhaustion, a calmer warning color for later exhaustion before reset, and increase forecast text readability in collapsed and expanded rows.

history.evidence: Audited the settings menu: indicator modes, tool filters, daily budget, language and quit all have handlers; launch-at-login uses SMAppService and now displays registration errors. Codex row now stacks clearly labeled used percentages, short forecast states the affected quota and estimated time, and expanded details keep the full explanation. Removed stale Claude/Cursor onboarding copy. 11 Python tests and Swift compatibility/forecast checks pass; app rebuilt and running; rendered Codex panel inspected; diff check clean.

Audited settings actions; Codex quota summary now explicitly reads as a forecast, split into “Previsão: cota 5h” and “Esgota em …”. Full pace explanation remains in expanded details. Startup errors are surfaced. Python and Swift tests pass; app rebuilt and rendered panel inspected.
Reopened after screenshot review found a weekly quota depletion alert extrapolated from only ~2 hours of usage; adding minimum-history safeguards and regression coverage.

Weekly Codex projections now wait for at least 24 hours of cycle history; shorter quota windows retain forecasts after one hour. Added regression checks for the screenshot case and for continued valid projections. Swift and 17 Python tests pass; app rebuilt and relaunched.
User reports the quota forecast overstates urgency in red and forecast copy is too small; revising severity and text hierarchy.

Forecasts that predict exhaustion more than 1 hour away now use amber; red is reserved for exhaustion within 1 hour. Forecast copy is 12.5 pt in the summary and expanded details, reset text is 11.5 pt. Swift tests, 17 Python tests, typography scan and rendered snapshot pass; app rebuilt and relaunched.

tasks.title: Limitar tempo de coleta e mostrar falhas corretamente
tasks.description: Adicionar timeout global, término de subprocessos e tratamento de exit status no coletor Swift. Uma fonte travada não deve manter atualização infinita nem esconder resultados das fontes saudáveis. Cobrir falha e timeout com verificação relevante.

history.evidence: Coletores executam isolados; falha/timeout de uma fonte não bloqueia fontes saudáveis. Cada fonte tem limite de 45s e encerra seu grupo de processos; Swift tem proteção de 90s, lê stdout/stderr simultaneamente e reporta exit status. Testes Python e Swift passaram; app reinstalado e cache real atualizado com Codex/OpenCode sem erros.
